infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: SiamEZ uses the camera so you can photograph passports, visas, and other documents for your booking or case.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: SiamEZ uses your photo library so you can attach existing document scans to your booking or case.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: SiamEZ uses the microphone for voice search so you can find services by speaking.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: SiamEZ uses speech recognition for voice search in English and Thai.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: SiamEZ uses your location while the app is open to verify task progress and share live transit updates with your client.
